name: Shy Turkey 95
author: JaydipPrajapati1910
description: Outlined rounded gray text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, border becomes 2px solid #c3c6ce, text color changes from #222 to #999.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Shy Turkey 95</title>
<style>
/* Shy Turkey 95 by JaydipPrajapati1910 — https://uiverse.io/JaydipPrajapati1910/shy-turkey-95 */
.input {
  max-width: 190px;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  background: none;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #222;
  padding: 15px 5px 10px 20px;
  box-shadow: Inset 0 1px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  border-radius: 25px;
}

.input:focus {
  border: 2px solid #c3c6ce;
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: #555;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.input:focus::placeholder {
  color: #999;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input class="input" name="text" type="text" placeholder="Name">

</body>
</html>
